pages.title: Tier one
pages.text: Built on the NASA Workbench: nose cone, body plating, fins and engine. Chests add cargo space. Tier one reaches the Moon and an Earth space station.

pages.title: Before launch
pages.text: Check your prelaunch list. Wear a parachute: without one, the fall when returning to Earth is deadly. Press $(k:Galaxy Map) for the map and check which rocket tier the target needs.

pages.title: What to bring
pages.text: Tanks, canned food, tools, glowstone torches and a way home: 9 $(l:space/start/fuel)pads$(), a $(l:space/start/fuel#loader)fuel loader$(), batteries and fuel canisters. After landing, your rocket waits in the lander.

pages.title: Galaxy map
pages.text: It shows the rocket tier a target needs.

pages.title: Tiers two and three
pages.text: The tier 2 schematic is in the Moon dungeon's treasure room and leads to $(l:space/planets/mars)Mars$(). A tier 3 rocket is needed for the $(l:space/planets/asteroids)asteroids$() and $(l:space/planets/venus)Venus$(), and its schematic waits on Mars.

pages.title: Higher tiers
pages.text: Rocket 4 opens after Venus and the third lander module. Rocket 5 comes before $(l:space/planets/proxima)Alpha Centauri$() and rocket 6 before $(l:space/planets/tau_ceti)Tau Ceti$(). Read more in the $(l:space/tech/high_rockets)Rockets 4-6$() entry.

pages.title: NASA Workbench
pages.text: Rockets are built here from schematics.

pages.title: Tier 1 Rocket
pages.text: Reaches the Moon and an Earth station.

pages.title: Tier 2 Rocket
pages.text: Its schematic is in the Moon's treasure room.

pages.title: Tier 3 Rocket
pages.text: Its schematic is in the Mars treasure room.

pages.title: Parachute
pages.text: Always wear it: it saves you from the fall.
